scope: 仅六英雄170级七式普通/真主武器12件的装备来源反气功预算；95件低阶段英雄主武器显式无此贡献。其他装备/首饰/道具不外推。

evidence.facts: 170级装备武器/衣服/护手/靴子/内甲/真装备/武勋装强化10及以上随强化增加反气功点；所有气功等级提升不影响反气功。

source_policy.project_adoption: 将170级英雄七式普通/真主武器明确列入本地装备点预算，真实强化10..15分别1..6点，普通/真同表；英雄适配与精确点数是项目值，来源未公开逐级表。
source_policy.not_source_proof: 强化14/15复合图中的全部气功3/1不是反气功点表，15+[n]不等于真实强化15+n。

input_policy.one_instance_once: current effective weapon instance only; bag/warehouse/secondary group never contribute; duplicate instance/lineage is state error, not sum twice
input_policy.qualification_loss: legitimately inactive equipment contributes0 with explicit eligibility reason under13/14; invalid definition/schema/unknown mapping is configuration error, not inactive0
input_policy.exact_lookup: bound12 use exact named profile; explicitly excluded95 have0. Item outside both lists requires its own adopted owner; never treat unknown ordinary armor/accessory as0
input_policy.enhancement_input: permanent integer enhancement0..15 only, validated by31; no parsing display strings, enhancement15+[4] remains real15 if valid independent boost state exists
input_policy.excluded_sources: awakening,synthesis,jade,evolution,four_divine,element_attribute,all_qigong_level and temporary/display boosts do not add or multiply this equipment budget

budget_application.formula: normal level budget from14 + active eligible equipment/accessory components from each explicit owner + legitimate item budget, then18 explicit override; hero weapon adds its own component exactly once, not standalone replacement total
budget_application.unlock: normal allocation/proc still requires170/rank12 under反气功.v1.json; budget source cannot grant twelve-turn completion or lower-level unlock
budget_application.pve_defense: 反气功.v1.json pve_defense consumes current final total budget once including unallocated points,2 defense per point only when unlocked. Do not add separate weapon PVE defense on top of total conversion.
budget_application.max_scope: this weapon component maximum6; level180+weapon15=22+6=28 only with no other equipment/item component and no18 override. This is not a global total budget cap.
budget_application.allocation_shrink: owner14: preview/confirm equipment change if new total<allocated, clear all anti allocations atomically with change, unallocated=new total; if enough preserve allocations. Cancellation changes nothing. Legitimate external qualification loss resolves at fixed-step boundary with reason. Invalid load is rejected, not repaired.
budget_application.cooldowns_and_existing_effects: clearing allocations does not reset attacker cooldowns or refresh existing successful effects; existing effect durations finish per反气功.v1.json lifecycle
budget_application.authority: LAN host derives from requester own effective equipment and committed revisions; clients never submit authoritative point totals

persistence.saved_inputs: equipment instance/definition/permanent enhancement/active group, learned allocated anti IDs and authoritative revisions; no permanent equipment-points wallet or cached hero point contribution
persistence.transaction: equip/unequip/switch/qualification/parameter change recomputes preview and committed final budget with same effective inventory revision; reject stale preview; if allocation reset confirmation missing reject change requiring reset
persistence.save_failure: keep committed equipment/allocation state and unsaved marker, retry identical snapshot only; no second reset/refund
persistence.load: validate all owner definitions/eligibility/exclusive lineage and allocated<=final budget after18 override. Invalid source or unexplained overbudget rejects, no default profile or fabricated change reason

remaining_dependencies: 非英雄170装备/170首饰逐件点数与取得、具名永久/临时道具点数仍待。
英雄武器天池神丹15+[n]状态已由英雄武器附加提升.v1.json采用且不参与本预算；其他提升道具/防具/属性提升及装备成长仍待。
Godot真实换装/分配/战斗/保存/LAN与经济平衡尚未实现验证。
